How do I update my contact or account details?

You can update your contact and account details right in your online account.

Here’s how:

Go to our website and click “Account” (or the person icon) at the top of the page.
Sign in with your email and password.
Once signed in:
To update your name, email, or phone: look for your account/profile details and edit the fields you want to change, then save.
To update addresses: open the “Addresses” or “Address book” section, edit an existing address or add a new one, then save.
To update your password: go to the password/security section, enter your current password and then your new one, and save.

If you run into any trouble updating something specific (like email or address), tell me what you’re trying to change and I can walk you through it step by step.

If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?

If your order is canceled and a refund is issued, it will be processed back to your original method of payment. It typically takes about 3 to 5 business days for the refund to show up on your end, depending on your bank or card issuer.

If you ever receive store credit instead of a refund to your card, that credit would be available for you to use right away.
